data.name: Homie - AI-Powered Household Management App
data.description: Mobile application designed to simplify and automate household management for students and roommates. Features AI-powered task automation, intelligent calendar integration, Splitwise-style expense tracking, and smart reminders. Homie ensures fair task distribution, reduces conflicts, and keeps everything organized in one centralized platform. Built with Figma for high-fidelity prototypes and UX design, focusing on seamless user experience for young professionals and students in shared living spaces.
